Project Plans 2026-2027
Roads Resurfacing Program
ID: 4C.18
Directorate: Infrastructure Services
Total Budget: $2,850,000
2026/27 Budget: $2,850,000
Start Date: July 2026
End Date: June 2027
Funding Source: Municipal, Roads to Recovery
Project Description
Annual program to resurface and rehabilitate local roads in poor condition.
Locations
• Elderberry Dr – South Lake to Berrigan Dr
• Warton Rd – Jandakot Rd to Nicholson Rd
• Beeliar Drive – Wentworth to Midgeegooroo Ave

Bibra Lake Skate Park Upgrade
ID: 3B.07
Directorate: Community Services
Total Budget $1,200,000
Budget 2026/27 $400,000
Start Date: 1 September 2026
End Date: 30 June 2028
Project Description
Upgrade of the skate park facilities at Bibra Lake.
